Dialogue: "We find retail more profitable than mercenary work, truthfully. But this one has never profited from such a noteworthy contract as the Fighters Guild."

Group: "You have a fondness for prisms and light? Is there money in that? As much money as killing daedra, perhaps?"

Dialogue: "Affairs in Eyevea, it is certain, go well enough. Well enough to spend freely and have not a care!"

Group: "The Madgod would encourage you to spend on trifles such as an acreage of cheese or shoes made of live cats. He and we are nothing alike. Spend here!"

Dialogue: "Undaunted! Undaunted? Dauntlessly spend your money here, friend."

Group: "We know, gold is meaningless when one could die tomorrow in another, stranger, dungeon rife with peril. Spend your money here instead!"
